_meta.note: Values are computed styles on the live public pages. The yellow hover and the 2px focus ring were read with the pointer and keyboard. Nothing was typed or submitted.

cream.source: computed backgroundColor of body and header on / (raw/components-computed.json, live reading body)

creamDeep.source: computed borderTopColor of login-email and contact field, and backgroundColor of cart-button hover

ink.source: computed color of body and backgroundColor of footer, login-submit and order-sample

white.source: computed backgroundColor of login-email and contact field, and color of footer text

yellow.source: computed backgroundColor of the New badge and of hero-cta and order-sample on hover

muted.source: computed color of the contact select placeholder

focusBlue.source: computed outlineColor of cart-button focus-visible (browser default on the icon button)

primary500.source: declared --color-primary-500 on :root (raw/css-vars.json). Not the fill of any measured public control

sans.source: @font-face family on the live home page, computed fontFamily of body

fallback.source: computed fontFamily stack after Helvetica Neue on body

display.source: computed style of h1 Textile Room on /collection

hero.source: computed style of the home hero headline (two lines, 168px box)

dialogTitle.source: computed style of Log in to continue

productTitle.source: computed style of the Blink heading

nav.source: computed style of the Textile Room header link

button.source: computed style of Explore samples and Login

label.source: computed style of the Pattern filter and Get in touch with sales

marquee.source: computed style of the sample marquee

none.source: computed border radius of body and page titles

pill.source: computed border radius of the cart icon button

badgeX.source: computed paddingLeft of the New badge
